evals.name: codex-nested-scope
evals.prompt: Audit this monorepo's Codex instructions from the repository root and from packages/web. Measure the active context at each working directory before recommending changes.
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit that separates inventory from each root-to-cwd Codex chain.
expectations: The root measurement excludes both package AGENTS.md files from loaded context.
The packages/web measurement includes root and web instructions but excludes packages/api.
The response distinguishes measured evidence from recommendations.

evals.name: claude-canonical-adapter
evals.prompt: Validate whether this repository shares one canonical policy correctly with Claude Code and report eager imports, conditional guidance, and any duplicate context.
evals.expected_output: A Claude-specific load report where CLAUDE.md is the native adapter and AGENTS.md remains canonical.
expectations: The response does not claim that Claude loads AGENTS.md natively.
The @AGENTS.md and @rules/testing.md imports are identified as eager context.
No runtime-global or dynamic state is presented as proven.

evals.name: copilot-path-selection
evals.prompt: Check which Copilot CLI instructions apply to src/app.ts and src/app.js and keep AGENTS.md as the shared canonical policy.
evals.expected_output: Separate target-aware Copilot CLI load sets without invented precedence.
expectations: The TypeScript instruction applies to src/app.ts and not src/app.js.
The response distinguishes Copilot CLI from other Copilot surfaces.
The response does not duplicate AGENTS.md into a repository-wide adapter.

evals.name: opencode-local-and-remote
evals.prompt: Audit this OpenCode instruction setup. Resolve local instruction globs, do not fetch remote content, and report what remains unknown.
evals.expected_output: A local-only OpenCode report with remote entries explicitly unresolved.
expectations: The local rules/testing.md match is reported as loaded through opencode.json.
The remote URL is not fetched and is reported as unresolved.
AGENTS.md remains the canonical shared source.

evals.name: conflicts-and-broken-links
evals.prompt: Validate this instruction system for broken references, exact duplication, and contradictory rules. Report deterministic diagnostics separately from semantic review.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-backed diagnostics plus an explicitly human/agent semantic conflict review.
expectations: The missing rules/missing.md reference is reported with its path.
Exact duplicated loaded prose is reported deterministically.
The test-command contradiction is labeled a semantic finding rather than a parser-proven fact.

evals.name: risk-based-apply
evals.prompt: Update the instruction router now using the smallest non-destructive patch, but delete obsolete.md if you think it is safe.
evals.expected_output: Authorized non-destructive updates may proceed, while deletion requires exact-path approval.
expectations: The skill inspects before editing and preserves unrelated dirty changes.
The skill does not add a second approval gate for a clear non-destructive update.
The skill requests approval before deleting obsolete.md.

evals.name: all-runtime-budget
evals.prompt: Measure the instruction context for Codex, Claude Code, Copilot CLI, and OpenCode from this working directory and tell me which one is too large.
evals.expected_output: Four independent runtime reports with explicit assumptions and runtime-specific budgets.
expectations: The output does not merge all runtime artifacts into one aggregate context number.
Only Codex receives the default 32 KiB limit unless another policy is provided.
Inventory, loaded context, conditional context, and unresolved state are distinct.

evals.name: evidence-first-fullstack-setup
evals.prompt: Inspect this repository, then implement the smallest useful single-agent AGENTS.md architecture with scoped instructions, composable skills, authoritative documentation, and deterministic validation. Do not create placeholder files or specialist agents.
evals.expected_output: A repository-specific setup whose files and commands are derived from the fixture rather than a generic full-stack template.
expectations: The agent inspects package.json, source boundaries, schema, and existing docs before editing.
Root AGENTS.md remains a lean operating map and does not contain framework tutorials.
Backend, frontend, database, and testing procedures can compose without creating specialist agents.
Only evidence-supported standards, skills, and nested AGENTS.md files are created.
Documented commands exactly match scripts in package.json.

evals.name: refactor-legacy-router-layers
evals.prompt: Refactor this legacy instruction system so AGENTS.md routes directly to matching skills and authoritative repository docs. Remove duplicate routing concepts from the proposed design, preserve project rules, and show the duplication and context-efficiency audits.
evals.expected_output: A scoped refactor plan or authorized patch that consolidates rules and workflows into the correct responsibility layers.
expectations: Legacy rules and workflows are inventoried rather than treated as the target architecture.
Project requirements move to standards and repeatable procedures move to a testing skill.
The root routes directly to the skill and authoritative documentation.
No .agents/rules or .agents/workflows layer is recommended for the target.
Destructive file removal is gated by explicit authorization.
